## Development Tasks

### 1. Goal Command Prompt Cache Preservation (MEDIUM ~4-6h)
**Source**: Kilocode 2026-09-30 carry-forward  
**What**: Cache tool schemas at goal start, freeze and reuse through goal loop to preserve prompt cache  
**Why**: Goal command repeatedly regenerates tool schemas on each turn, breaking prompt cache and wasting tokens  
**Files**: `src/agent/`, `src/tool/registry.ts`, potentially `src/core/orchestrator.ts`  
**Category**: agent + tools  
**Size**: SMALL ~4-6h

### 2. Oversized Tool Result Caching (MEDIUM ~8-12h)
**Source**: Cline 2026-10-01 carry-forward  
**What**: Session memory cache with recovery URIs for MCP/external tool results, LRU eviction at 16 MiB  
**Why**: Large tool outputs (build logs, grep results) overflow context; need session-scoped cache with iteration eviction  
**Files**: `src/mcp/`, `src/tool/`, potentially new `src/core/toolResultCache.ts`  
**Category**: mcp + tool  
**Size**: MEDIUM ~8-12h (2-3 days)

### 3. Prompt Cache Breakpoint Gating (MEDIUM ~2-3h)
**Source**: Kilocode 2026-09-29 carry-forward  
**What**: Add endpoint detection to distinguish first-party vs custom OpenAI providers before enabling prompt cache  
**Why**: Custom OpenAI providers may not support prompt cache breakpoints; sending them causes errors  
**Files**: `src/providers/`, potentially `src/config/routing-config.json`  
**Category**: provider  
**Size**: SMALL ~2-3h

### 4. OpenCode Rotation Update (administrative)
**Source**: Research rotation recommendation  
**What**: Update `.github/prompts/agent1-research-system.md` to mark OpenCode as monthly polling  
**Why**: OpenCode dryness 12/10 (140% over rotation threshold of 5/5), zero NEW CLI-actionable items for 12 consecutive polls  
**Status**: Proposal already made in 2026-09-26 research; needs administrative update only (not an engineering issue)
